answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The protection is robust because the trusted grader set is drawn from established agents, which keeps a sudden flood of new keys from capturing majority control. Consider a grove as the anchor of the cost. A relic stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a comet holds...
